item.title: 修复（telegram）：在详细模式下保持已禁用的进度信息隐藏
item.summary: fix(telegram): keep disabled progress hidden in verbose mode Telegram now treats disabled tool progress as authoritative even when /verbose is enabled. Enabled progress and durable/final messages retain existing behavior. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi Co-authored-by: Jason O'Neal Co-authored-by: 徐金城0668000897
